questoes.pergunta: Lake Workshop reports repeated entries but the cause is unknown. What should the rep do before recommending a tool?
alternativas: Ask where duplication occurs and verify the underlying task.
Guarantee lower costs to create interest.
Send an agreement because every workshop needs software.
questoes.justificativa: Discovery checks whether the offer fits. A reported difficulty does not establish its cause or guarantee savings.

questoes.pergunta: Which statement is a testable value hypothesis?
alternativas: The tool will eliminate all errors.
We can test whether a shared record helps your team check duplicate entries.
Every buyer will grow revenue.
questoes.justificativa: The second statement proposes a contextual benefit to test. The other statements promise results without evidence.

questoes.pergunta: The buyer expects historical paper records to be entered, but that work is excluded. What is the appropriate action?
alternativas: Let the buyer assume it is included.
Blame the buyer for misunderstanding.
Clarify the exclusion before agreement and evaluate the separate need.
questoes.justificativa: Scope must be clear before commitment. Silence and blame do not resolve the expectation.

questoes.pergunta: Which condition checks delivery of account setup?
alternativas: Two test accounts complete the workflow defined in the agreed scope.
The buyer necessarily doubles revenue.
No user ever needs support.
questoes.justificativa: An observed workflow checks a specified deliverable. Future revenue and absence of all questions are not setup guarantees.

questoes.pergunta: A workshop orders equipment on a website for business use. Does the online channel alone make this B2C?
alternativas: Yes, every website purchase is B2C.
No, the parties and use context still matter.
Yes, B2B requires a site visit.
questoes.justificativa: Channel does not determine buying context. Businesses can buy online.

questoes.pergunta: A supervisor tests the workflow and the owner approves spending. Which question remains relevant?
alternativas: What is the supervisor’s personal income?
Which person is easiest to pressure?
Who reviews terms and formalises the agreement?
questoes.justificativa: The contracting path is relevant to the decision; personal income and pressure are not a substitute for understanding it.

questoes.pergunta: A colleague hands over a record labelled “hot lead”. What would improve it?
alternativas: Confirmed problem, participants, unknowns and a buyer-accepted next step.
More enthusiastic punctuation.
Treating every assumption as confirmed.
questoes.justificativa: A factual handoff enables continuity. A label or artificial certainty does not.

questoes.pergunta: The only buyer statement is “we want something modern”. Which response is neutral?
alternativas: You mean AI, correct?
What would you like to do that is difficult today?
How much money do you lose without our product?
questoes.justificativa: The neutral question explores the task without imposing a technology or financial loss.

questoes.pergunta: The offer supports one location and up to five users. The prospect requires ten connected locations. What is the correct initial assessment?
alternativas: Qualified, because larger firms always buy.
Qualified if the contact is friendly.
Outside the stated scope; check an authorised alternative before promising fit.
questoes.justificativa: Product scope limits fit. Size and friendliness do not solve the operational mismatch.

questoes.pergunta: A business email address appears on a public page. What follows?
alternativas: Record the source; any use still needs the applicable purpose, privacy and channel checks.
It can be used for any campaign indefinitely.
It can be combined with sensitive personal data to pressure the buyer.
questoes.justificativa: A public source is not blanket permission for every purpose. The organisation must use its approved procedures.

questoes.pergunta: Which sequence avoids a premature conclusion?
alternativas: How much are you losing? Why is your team failing? Will you buy today?
How does it work now? Can you describe a recent example? Have I understood the difficulty correctly?
Do you agree our product is the best?
questoes.justificativa: The second sequence explores context, an example and confirmation. The alternatives lead or pressure the buyer.

questoes.pergunta: The buyer says they may review the offer later but wants marketing messages stopped now. What is a faithful record?
alternativas: Purchase confirmed for later.
Continue weekly reminders.
Future interest uncertain; stop the requested contact and record the preference through the approved process.
questoes.justificativa: Possible future interest is not a commitment and does not cancel an explicit stop request.

questoes.pergunta: An account fits the product but has a recorded no-contact request. What should you do?
alternativas: Keep it out of the outreach sequence and respect the restriction.
Use another sender to test the refusal.
Ask a colleague to contact the same person instead.
questoes.justificativa: Fit does not override a stop request. Changing the sender to evade it is inappropriate.

questoes.pergunta: Which opening invents context?
alternativas: Replying to your enquiry, when an enquiry exists.
Following our meeting, when no meeting occurred.
I am from the supplier and would like to check relevance, through an approved channel.
questoes.justificativa: Inventing a meeting creates a false relationship. Identity and context must be truthful.

questoes.pergunta: The contact confirms a relevant problem but does not know the funding process. How should that field be recorded?
alternativas: Approved, because the problem is important.
Zero, because no amount was given.
Unknown; explore the approval process at an appropriate point.
questoes.justificativa: Unknown funding is neither approved nor zero. Preserve uncertainty rather than filling a field by assumption.

questoes.pergunta: The buyer asks for a discount outside your authority. What is appropriate?
alternativas: Clarify the constraint and consult the authorised owner without promising approval.
Grant it first and ask for approval later.
Promise that the discount guarantees financial results.
questoes.justificativa: Delegated authority limits commitments. Consultation preserves both trust and a valid negotiation.

questoes.pergunta: One account cannot access the service. The rep wants to publish a success story. What should happen first?
alternativas: Require three referrals.
Route the access issue and confirm actual delivery before declaring success.
Publish a testimonial without checking permission.
questoes.justificativa: Delivery has not been confirmed while the issue remains unresolved. Referrals and publicity do not replace support.

questoes.pergunta: A fictional RYCS exercise contains no payment amount or release conditions. Can it establish your earnings?
alternativas: Yes, it represents every live campaign.
Yes, multiply the number of contacts by any example price.
No, actual opportunity terms and valid activity determine the applicable conditions.
questoes.justificativa: A learning example does not create remuneration terms, availability or a promise of income.

questoes.pergunta: A task requires a meeting that was held. The only evidence is an accepted invitation. What does it show by itself?
alternativas: Scheduling acceptance, not confirmed attendance.
Attendance by every invitee.
Automatic approval of payment.
questoes.justificativa: Scheduling, attendance and review are distinct events. Evidence must support the specific claim.

questoes.pergunta: A review says the evidence shows only scheduling. You know the meeting was postponed. What is correct?
alternativas: Alter the screenshot to imply attendance.
Acknowledge the fact and correct the status through the available process, preserving record integrity.
Rename the same attachment as completed meeting.
questoes.justificativa: A correction must reflect the event. A changed image or title cannot establish an activity that did not happen.

criterios.practical_requirement: Required by the educational model; not enforced by the current platform.

learner_instruction: Answer without the key first. Review explanations afterwards and revisit the linked lessons. All scenarios are fictional.
instructor_instruction: Keep correct answers server-side or in the instructor review package. Do not expose the answer key before submission. Questions assess the same learning outcomes across markets; teaching cases and scripts are independently localised.
